title: Cancellation Notice and Notice Period, Resort Club Memberships Agreement Terms
content:
**Term 1 — Signed notice.** A member of Resort Club Memberships cancels only by signing a cancellation notice where the level requires notices to be signed; the notice date is the day the signed notice is received, and a request by phone or at the club desk has no effect until it is signed.

**Term 2 — Notice period.** The membership terminates the level's cancellation notice period, in calendar days, after the notice date, and dues remain payable until then.

**Term 3 — Termination at the end of the notice period.** A membership terminates only once its notice period has run. The notice period is counted in whole calendar days from the notice date, which is day zero; the membership is terminated on the last day of the count.

**Term 4 — Guest passes.** Remaining guest passes lapse on termination.

## What the terms mean for the membership record

| Stage | Status of the membership | What the record shows |
|---|---|---|
| Cancellation requested by phone or at the club desk, notice not yet signed | Unchanged (active or frozen) | A cancellation notice awaiting signature, if one has been prepared |
| Signed cancellation notice received | Notice given | The notice date, being the day the signed notice was received |
| Last day of the notice period | Terminated | The termination date; any guest passes left lapse |

A membership that is active or frozen moves to notice given when the member's signed cancellation notice is received. A cancellation notice given on a permanent move appears on the notice records as a relocation cancellation notice and is a cancellation notice in the same way.

## Counting the notice period (hypothetical dates)

For a signed notice received on 10 April, 10 April is day zero.

| Notice period of the level | Last day of the count, on which the membership is terminated |
|---|---|
| 30 calendar days | 10 May |
| 60 calendar days | 9 June |

On a 30-day notice period the notice period has not run on 9 May, day 29, and the membership does not terminate that day; it terminates on 10 May, day 30.

## Questions answered by the terms

**Does a phone call cancelling the membership start the notice period?** No. A request by phone or at the club desk has no effect until it is signed; the notice date is the day the signed notice is received.

**Are dues still owed during the notice period?** Yes. Dues remain payable until the membership terminates.

**What happens to unused guest passes?** They lapse on termination.
